description: This file defines the SetCookie class in the GuzzleHttp library, representing an HTTP cookie with parsing, serialization, validation, and matching functionalities.

classes.name: SetCookie
classes.description: Represents an HTTP cookie, capable of parsing a Set-Cookie header string, serializing to a string, and managing cookie attributes like domain, path, expiry, security flags, and validation.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SetCookie instance by parsing a Set-Cookie header string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetCookie object with optional attribute data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the cookie object back into a Set-Cookie header string format.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the cookie data as an associative array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the cookie's name.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie's value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie's value.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie's domain.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the cookie's domain.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie's path attribute.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the cookie's path attribute.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Retrieves the max-age attribute of the cookie.

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the max-age attribute of the cookie.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: setExpires
methods.description: Sets the expiry timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: getSecure
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is secure.

methods.name: setSecure
methods.description: Sets the secure flag of the cookie.

methods.name: getDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is a discard/session cookie.

methods.name: setDiscard
methods.description: Sets the discard/session flag of the cookie.

methods.name: getHttpOnly
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is HTTP-only.

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.description: Sets the HTTP-only flag of the cookie.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks whether the cookie's path matches a given request path.

methods.name: matchesDomain
methods.description: Checks whether the cookie's domain matches a given domain.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines if the cookie has expired based on current time.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cookie's name, value, and domain according to RFC 6265.
